decisions.reason: The aggregate one-ticket-per-mint rule and random-ticket accounting were already present, and the existing same-message MODIFY captures surface consistency and backfill requirements.
The FAQ already states that no-referral prize tickets go to a random existing NFT holder, and the source does not require a distinct copy change.
Issuing one ticket for a no-referral mint does not change the Small Block prize amount, draw interval, funding, eligibility window, or reset behavior.
This Requirement governs code-used mints, which the source explicitly reports as already accurate; the change concerns no-referral issuance.
A complete same-message MODIFY already records that every completed primary mint, including a no-referral mint, issues one $5 commission.
A complete same-message MODIFY already requires tickets and commissions from no-referral random allocation to appear in NFT attributes.
A randomly selected existing NFT holder now receives an eligible Small Block ticket from a no-referral mint, so winner eligibility cannot remain limited to referral affiliates of the block.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
At this point, we have completed 12 mints, so that should amount to 12 tickets & 12 x $5 commissions.

**Even if no referral code is used, a ticket and commission are still issued**.

Currently, **when a code is used**, it is accurately reflected on the leaderboards/NFT attributes. Perfect.

If **no referral code is used**, the ticket and commission are assigned at random.
(B**ut they must still be reflected on the leaderboard/NFT attributes**.)

I believe that since your most recent fix, the randomly assigned tickets from the last 2 mints have been reflected on the leaderboard/NFT attributes. Great.
However, the missing tickets have not been backfilled.

The commissions from these purchases without a code are also still not reflected on the leaderboard/NFT attributes.

In my screenshot, you will see that I have an NFT showing 2 tickets but only 1 x $5 commission. That should not be possible because each ticket includes a $5 commission.

Also, in my leaderboard screenshot, only 7 tickets and 5 x $5 commissions are accounted for out of 12 total mints.
Whether or not a referral code is used, 12 mints should result in 12 tickets and 12 x $5 commissions.

value_updates.eligible_population: Holders of eligible Small Block tickets, including existing NFT holders randomly assigned a ticket from a no-referral mint

decisions.reason: No-referral ticket issuance does not alter automatic prize delivery to a winner's wallet.
The ticket-allocation decision does not change winner announcement or notification channels.
The source changes no public prize-pool value or next-draw counter behavior.
The existing blank-or-invalid-code feedback already states that one $500 prize-draw ticket goes to an existing NFT holder at random.
Confirming one no-referral ticket per mint does not change the $15 price or the current $5 founder, $5 commission, and $5 prize-pool allocation.
